title: Free DIY Repair Directory
tagline: Official, genuinely free places to learn how to fix your own appliances, gadgets, cars and clothes — with the proof of free included on every card.

policy.affiliate_statement: Every link on this page goes straight to the official organization's own website. This directory earns no commissions, contains no affiliate or tracking parameters, and never suggests a purchase.
policy.cost_note: Free here means the instructions, manuals, diagrams or recall data. Replacement parts are a separate, always-optional cost.
policy.offline: This page is a single HTML file. Save it anywhere and open it without internet; the data travels with it.

categories.label: Appliance
categories.description: Manuals, part diagrams and how-to help for washers, dryers, fridges, ranges and dishwashers.

categories.label: Tech
categories.description: Phone, laptop and gadget repair guides, including official manufacturer service manuals.

categories.label: Auto
categories.description: Car repair libraries, recall lookups and maintenance help.

categories.label: Home
categories.description: Sewing, mending and household basics from universities and manufacturers.

categories.label: Safety & Recalls
categories.description: Recall checks, government data, and the boundaries where DIY should stop and a pro should take over.

cards.title: GE Appliances Owner Support: Manuals & Diagrams
cards.covers: Free owner's manuals and installation instructions for GE, Hotpoint and Cafe appliances — fridges, dishwashers, ovens, washers and dryers — plus the same official pages that carry part lists.
cards.free_proof: Manuals and installation guides download free straight from GE's own support site, with no account or payment. GE is the manufacturer, so this is the primary source — not a middleman reselling scanned documents.

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here if you own a GE appliance. Knowing the model's intended behavior is the safest first step before loosening any screw.

extras: Also covers Monogram and GE water heater lines.
Have your model number ready — a sticker inside the door or on the back.

cards.title: Whirlpool Owner Center: Brand-Official Manuals
cards.covers: Free owner's manuals, care guides and how-to articles for Whirlpool, Maytag, KitchenAid, JennAir and Amana, all published by the brands' parent company.
cards.free_proof: Every manual is a free download from Whirlpool's official owner center; the company publishes them so owners can service their own machines.

beginner_verdict.label: easy_confident
beginner_verdict.text: Easy with a little care: search your model number, skim the troubleshooting table first, then attempt the fix it describes.

extras: One archive covers five of the most common appliance brands.

cards.title: Samsung Support: Free Downloads & Manuals
cards.covers: Free manuals, firmware and troubleshooting guides for Samsung washers, fridges, dishwashers, TVs and phones — current models plus many older ones still listed.
cards.free_proof: Samsung hosts current and legacy manuals free under its official Support > Downloads section; downloads start without creating an account.

beginner_verdict.label: easy_confident
beginner_verdict.text: Easy with a little care, and it doubles as a tech archive: the same page covers phones, so you get two resource types in one place.

extras: Legacy model pages still load — useful for a 10-year-old washer.

cards.title: Sears PartsDirect: Exploded-View Part Diagrams
cards.covers: Exploded-view diagrams for thousands of appliance models: every part pictured, named and numbered, so you can see how a washer comes apart before you touch it.
cards.free_proof: Browsing diagrams, model pages and their repair guides is free — no membership. You only pay if you decide to order a physical part.

beginner_verdict.label: easy_confident
beginner_verdict.text: Easy with a little care: enter a model number, study the diagram, and decide whether the repair is within reach before spending anything.

extras: Diagrams and guides are free; parts are the optional paid piece.

cards.title: AppliancePartsPros: Diagrams + How-To Videos
cards.covers: Free exploded-view diagrams for washers, dryers, fridges, ranges and dishwashers, paired with thousands of short videos showing the actual disassembly for common repairs.

official_source.name: AppliancePartsPros (parts retailer with free repair library)

cards.free_proof: Diagrams, symptom guides and how-to videos are free to view; payment happens only if you order a part from them.

beginner_verdict.label: easy_confident
beginner_verdict.text: Easy with a little care: the videos show the whole fix start to finish, so pause, rewatch and follow along with the machine unplugged.

extras: Look for the 'Repair Video' flag on a part or model's page.

cards.title: RepairClinic: Symptom-to-Fix DIY Library
cards.covers: A free library that turns 'my fridge is making noise' into the likely part and the repair steps, for appliances, HVAC and small engines, with model-specific how-to videos.
cards.free_proof: The symptom pages, repair help and thousands of instruction videos are viewable free; no subscription is required to learn how to do the fix.

beginner_verdict.label: take_it_slow
beginner_verdict.text: Take it slow: symptom-based advice is a good starting diagnosis, but confirm the part with your model's diagram before ordering anything.

extras: Unplug or disconnect water and gas lines before opening anything.

cards.title: iFixit Repair Guides (Phones, Laptops & More)
cards.covers: Free, community-tested, step-by-step guides for iPhones, Android phones, laptops, tablets, game consoles and gadgets, with photos of every screw, snap and connector.

official_source.name: iFixit (B Corp; publishes open repair manuals)

cards.free_proof: Guides are free to read, forever. iFixit sells optional tools and parts, but the instructions themselves are never paywalled — that is their stated mission.

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here: search your exact model ('iPhone 13 battery replacement') and the step photos make the repair feel surprisingly doable.

extras: Read the 'difficulty' and warning blurb at the top of any guide first.
Their free teardowns show what is inside a device before you buy it.

cards.title: Apple Self Service Repair: Official Service Manuals
cards.covers: Official service manuals — hundreds of pages of genuine Apple procedures — plus genuine part ordering options for iPhone, MacBook, iMac and other Apple products.
cards.free_proof: Apple publishes the repair manuals as free downloads from its own support site; the parts store is optional and the decades of manuals cost nothing.

beginner_verdict.label: take_it_slow
beginner_verdict.text: Take it slow: these manuals are thorough but written with technician-level care. Try the friendlier iFixit steps for the same fix first, then cross-check here.

extras: A tiny adhesive or a bent cable is the usual villain in laptop repairs.

cards.title: Framework: Official Laptop Repair Guides
cards.covers: Official, full teardown-and-replace guides for Framework laptops — RAM, SSD, battery, keyboard, screen, port modules — designed so owners do exactly what technicians do.
cards.free_proof: Every repair guide is free on Framework's official site; the company builds laptops to be user-repairable and publishes its documentation openly.

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here: this is the friendliest laptop-repair source anywhere, with standard Phillips screws and no knowledge assumed.

extras: Great first-repair candidate: a RAM or storage upgrade with one screwdriver.

cards.title: ChiltonLibrary: Free with Your Library Card
cards.covers: The full Chilton auto-repair manuals — step-by-step procedures, wiring diagrams, torque specs and maintenance schedules — for decades of car, truck and SUV models.
cards.free_proof: ChiltonLibrary is a paid database, but public libraries subscribe and cardholders use it free. Look for it on your library's website under 'A–Z databases' or 'Auto repair'.

beginner_verdict.label: easy_confident
beginner_verdict.text: Easy with a little care: search by year, make and model. The wording is technician-grade, so read one step at a time and follow exactly.

extras: No library card yet? Most US libraries issue one free at the desk in minutes.

cards.title: AutoZone DIY Repair Guides
cards.covers: Free guides for common car jobs — brakes, batteries, belts, fluids, wipers — plus check-engine-light code lookup by year, make and model.

official_source.name: AutoZone (retailer with free DIY resource section)

cards.free_proof: Published free on AutoZone's official DIY section; reading the guides requires nothing beyond the website, even though the company obviously hopes you buy parts.

beginner_verdict.label: easy_confident
beginner_verdict.text: Easy with a little care: the most common fixes (battery, air filter, wipers, bulbs) are genuinely beginner-friendly here.

extras: Their free code-reading service at many stores can point to the actual issue.

cards.title: NHTSA Recall Search and Vehicle Safety Data
cards.covers: Free lookup of US vehicle recalls, open investigations and complaints by VIN or make/model — including whether the manufacturer's fix is free at a dealer.
cards.free_proof: It is a federal government service: recall and safety data is public, and the VIN search is free with no registration.

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here before any car repair: a recalled part might be replaced free at the dealer, turning a scary diagnostic into a free fix.

extras: Your VIN is visible through the windshield on the driver's side.

cards.title: SINGER / PFAFF / Husqvarna Viking: Free Machine Manuals
cards.covers: Free, model-specific PDF manuals for SINGER, PFAFF and HUSQVARNA VIKING sewing machines — threading diagrams, tension fixes, bobbin troubleshooting and routine maintenance.
cards.free_proof: The official page states plainly: 'Download free, model-specific PDF guides … for setup, maintenance and troubleshooting.' Singer also confirms manuals are 'exclusively online for free download.'

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here: threading and tension problems cause most 'broken' sewing machines, and the manual's diagrams solve both in minutes.

extras: Model number is printed on the machine — usually the body or plate near the needle arm.

cards.title: Clothing Repair Guide (University Extension, Free PDF)
cards.covers: A plain-language university extension publication on 'to mend or not to mend': judging the damage, assembling a simple mending kit, patching, split seams, loose hems, buttons and reinforcements.

official_source.name: University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension Service

cards.free_proof: State university extension publications are free educational documents — no purchase, subscription or account, produced for the public.

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here: it is short enough to read in one sitting and matches exactly what a beginner mending box actually needs.

extras: Pairs nicely with a machine manual when a repair needs machine stitching.

cards.title: Sewing for Beginners (4-H Extension, Free PDF)
cards.covers: A longer free 4-H publication covering tools, hand stitches, machine threading, seams, hems and simple projects — the practical basics that make mending feel routine.

official_source.name: University of New Hampshire Cooperative Extension (4-H)

cards.free_proof: An official UNH Extension resource, downloadable as a free PDF from the university's own site.

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here when you want more than a one-page answer: it teaches the underlying skills, not just one trick.

extras: The stitches section doubles as hand-mending reference for clothes that never see a machine.

cards.title: CPSC Recall Search (Products Safety)
cards.covers: Free search of US consumer-product recalls — fridges, dehumidifiers, space heaters, chargers, smoke detectors and more — including free repair kits, refunds or replacements offered by makers.

official_source.name: US Consumer Product Safety Commission (federal agency)

cards.free_proof: Federal agency: recall data is public and free, and the agency is the authoritative source for product-safety notices.

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here before any appliance fix: if the problem is a recalled part, the manufacturer may repair or replace it free — that is a better deal than DIY.

extras: Recalled dehumidifiers and space heaters are recurring fire risks.

cards.title: Recalls.gov: One Door for All US Recall Data
cards.covers: The federal portal that hands off to the right agency across appliances (CPSC), vehicles and child restraints (NHTSA), food and drugs, and more.
cards.free_proof: Government-run portal; all data behind it is public and free of charge.

beginner_verdict.label: start_here
beginner_verdict.text: Start here when you are unsure which agency covers the item: one search avoids guessing between federal websites.

extras: Use CPSC's site directly for appliance detail; this portal is the front door.

cards.title: When Repair Gets Scary: Pro-Territory Boundaries
cards.covers: The DIY stopping lines: anything with natural or propane gas; electrical panel or wiring work; power near water; refrigerant; structural items; and anything behind a recall notice that involves gas or electrics.

official_source.name: NFPA (National Fire Protection Association) — consumer safety education

cards.free_proof: NFPA publishes consumer-facing safety education free on its site; the Electrical Safety Foundation (ESFI) and utility safety pages are likewise free to the public.

beginner_verdict.label: pro_territory
beginner_verdict.text: Pro territory: smelling gas, panel upgrades, damaged wiring and refrigerant are for licensed pros. Knowing when to stop is a beginner skill that beats heroics — every time.

extras: Smell gas? Leave the area and call your utility's emergency line from outside.
ESFI (esfi.org) is a good second source on electrical safety.
Unplug before opening; discharge and follow device-specific guides first.
